about_the_game:
<Finding Cats>: A Furry Fairy Tale Hidden-Object Adventure!

Ready to dive into a fairy tale world made of paws and purrs? Cats Everywhere is a uniquely creative hidden-object and clicker adventure that gives the beloved story of Snow White a fantastic "feline" twist!

Gameplay & Experience:

  • Fairy Tale Scenes, Feline Hunt: Explore beautifully recreated classic scenes from Snow White. But this time, you must scour these detailed scenes with a sharp eye to find all the cleverly hidden cats.

  • Click to Discover: The gameplay is simple and intuitive. Just move and click your mouse to mark each discovered cat, enjoying the pure joy of finding them all.

  • A Horde of Cats to Collect: Countless cats are hiding in every nook and cranny! From a regal "Prince Cat" to chubby "Dwarf Cats," every uniquely designed feline is waiting to be discovered and added to your album.

Key Features:

  • When Fairy Tales Meet Cats: This is the core charm! Witness the classic tale retold by an all-cat cast, filled with unexpected humor and warmth. Is the Evil Queen a haughty Persian? Are the seven dwarfs a bunch of cute Munchkins? Discover the purr-fect parody for yourself!

  • A World Rich with Details: Every scene is meticulously illustrated, not only capturing the fairy tale magic but also packed with fun feline-themed details and Easter eggs, rewarding your careful exploration.

Calling all cat lovers and fairy tale fans! Sharpen your "cat-like reflexes" and step into this magical, adorable world for a cozy and addictive hidden-object adventure!
